_comment: Distinct rate sources for AUTO (Issue #4). The authoritative route->source mapping is MarketRegistryEntry.distinct_rate_source_id in data/market_registry/auto.json. Records here are supplementary (evidence) and are validated on load so related_registry_ids can never contradict the registry. Rate sources are added ONLY after a route is verified and are never guessed. Verified sources: RS-ZURICH-AUTO (Square One, Zurich) and RS-SONNET-AUTO (Sonnet, Sonnet Insurance Company).

records.notes: Square One Ontario car insurance is underwritten by Zurich Insurance Company Ltd (Canadian Branch).
Sonnet Ontario auto policies are underwritten by Sonnet Insurance Company (official evidence confirmed). Maps ONLY the sonnet registry route - distinct from RS-ZURICH-AUTO.
